characters.name: Alysson
characters.clueEn: She was exactly one column west of George.
characters.clueZh:
正好在 George
西边一列。

characters.name: Brenda
characters.clueEn: She was sitting on a chair. She was alone with a man.
characters.clueZh:
坐在一把椅子上。和一个男人
单独在一起。

characters.name: Cynthia
characters.clueEn: She was in the first column. She was south of Alysson.
characters.clueZh:
在第一列。
在 Alysson 南边。

characters.name: Elsa
characters.clueEn: There was a man sitting on a chair in her area.
characters.clueZh:
她所在的区域里有一个男人坐在
一把椅子上。

characters.name: George
characters.clueEn: He was either beside a statue or some rubble.
characters.clueZh:
在一座雕像
或一堆瓦砾旁边。

characters.name: Hugh
characters.clueEn: He was beside some rubble. He was not in the Lobby.
characters.clueZh:
在一堆瓦砾旁边。
不在大厅里。

characters.name: Vicky
characters.clueEn: The Victim. She was alone with the murderer.
characters.clueZh: 被害者。和凶手单独在一起。
